title: Rulings of Taharah and Wudu in Islam
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text discusses the rulings of taharah (ritual purification) and wudu and their importance in Islam. It mentions some du'a and actions associated with taharah, such as istinshaq (inhaling water into the nose) and istijmar (cleansing with stones or the like). It also refers to some Prophetic hadiths that clarify the virtue of taharah.

review_defects.why: The Arabic plural 'ad'iyah' (supplications) is rendered as singular/uncountable 'du'a', losing the plural sense.
